messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Financial Transactions" as it appears in the following examples.
['I am Mr AYO Radio I need your services in a confidential manner regarding money transfer.', 'THIS WILL State THAT THE SUM OF £ NINE MILLION POUNDS HAS BEEN DEPOSITED WITH A SECURITY VAULT IN OVERSEAS FOR THE ENTIRE FAMILY.', 'With me here your claims will be approved without any delay and the funds will be transferred to your nominated bank account.', 'I am saddled with the problem of securing a trustworthy foreign personality who will take me as a son, to help me transfer the money over to your country with the intention of investing it in a business under your directives and supervisions because I have no knowledge of investment until I finished up my Education.', 'The last of my belonging which no one knows of, is the huge deposit of Million, Five Hundred Thousand US dollars that I have in a safe keeping company abroad, which I will want you to secure and bestow to charity organizations.', 'The Central Bank of Nigeria in Conjunction With the International Monetary Fund (IMF is given out a compensation to victims of scam perpetrated by Nigeria scammers.', 'Bearing in mind that your assistance is needed to transfer this fund, I propose commission of 20% (Twenty percent) of the total sum to you for the expected services and assistance.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "I seek help transferring, securing, and investing large overseas funds, promising commissions and describing deposits, compensation, and charitable intentions."}
